method: Opened all four supplied official/developer URLs with the web reader and inspected relevant original page text.
scope: Published documentation, not a hands-on current-version test of the original games.
media_policy: Link-only. No downloaded game media, screenshots, logos, sprites or trademark graphics.

sources.title: Celeste & Forgiveness
sources.location: Sections 1 Coyote Time and 2 Jump Buffering
sources.confirmed: Brief ledge departure grace; jump held shortly before landing causes a jump on the landing frame.
sources.proposal: 100 ms grace, 120 ms buffer, 600 ms event, 0.5x analytical replay, controls and fictional art.
sources.not_confirmed: Exact Celeste timing constants, every release/platform, full movement physics.

sources.title: Waypoint Update
sources.location: 4.0 Patch notes → User interface and quality of life → Interaction targeting
sources.confirmed: Nearby objects highlighted without precise aiming.
sources.proposal: Exact vs nearby fixture, 70/30 scoring, explicit cycling, selection retention, range/occlusion/completion guards.
sources.not_confirmed: Internal candidate algorithm, scoring, occlusion behavior, all current editions.

sources.title: The Last of Us Part II: Accessibility Features Detailed
sources.location: HUD → Damage/Awareness Indicators; Motion Sickness → Camera Shake; Magnification and Visual Aids → HUD Flashing
sources.confirmed: Directional damage spikes and awareness indications with stealth/always modes; camera-shake adjustment and HUD-flashing on/off.
sources.proposal: Original lightning/eye symbols, independent damage and exposure buttons, numeric exposure, flash intensity and isolated one-pulse effect.
sources.not_confirmed: Demo effects matching the game, continuous flash slider in the game, comprehensive accessibility, every current release.

sources.title: ELDEN RING Starter Guide: Tips to know before playing the game
sources.location: Game Environment → Stakes of Marika and Death
sources.confirmed: Last rested Site of Grace or nearby Stake of Marika return; all carried runes drop on death; another death before collection loses that drop.
sources.proposal: Fictional shards, Home/Relay names and positions, 125/25 amounts, explicit return/cancel menu, available-checkpoint toggle.
sources.not_confirmed: All original-game exceptions, all current versions, original map or original recovery UI.
